description:
**OPEN VIEWING THIS SATURDAY 5TH SEPTEMBER FROM 10AM TO 10.45 **
GVM Auctioneers are delighted to present to the market this beautifully appointed red-brick, six-bedroom detached residence, superbly positioned in the established and much sought-after development of Castleville, just off the highly regarded Golf Links Road in the leafy suburb of Castletroy.


Set at the end of a quiet and charming cul-de-sac comprising exclusively detached homes, this superb property enjoys an outstanding location just a short stroll from the beautifully manicured fairways of Castletroy Golf Club and within walking distance of the University of Limerick and Plassey Technological Park.



The area offers an enviable range of amenities, including excellent primary and secondary schools and renowned sporting facilities such as Monaleen GAA Club, Aisling Annacotty FC and UL Bohemian RFC. There is also a wonderful selection of nearby retail parks, shopping centres, chic coffee shops, excellent restaurants and welcoming hostelries, together with recreational parks and picturesque riverside walks ideal for family enjoyment.



No. 10 is a most attractive and elegant home offering bright, spacious and exceptionally well-proportioned living and bedroom accommodation, thoughtfully arranged to meet the needs of modern family life.



At ground-floor level, there are three excellent reception rooms, providing tremendous flexibility for both formal entertaining and relaxed family living. These are complemented by a well-appointed kitchen/breakfast room, utility room and guest wc.

Upstairs, there are six generously proportioned bedrooms and three bathrooms. The converted attic provides further valuable space and is ideally suited for use as a home office, games room, studio or additional storage.



Outside, the property benefits from a particularly pleasant aspect, capturing both morning and afternoon sunshine. The private and picturesque rear garden provides a wonderful setting for outdoor dining, entertaining guests or simply relaxing in peaceful surroundings.

This is a wonderful opportunity for those seeking an exclusive and substantial detached family home in what is unquestionably one of the most sought-after and established residential developments in the greater Monaleen and Castletroy area. 

Inspection of this superb property is very highly recommended.
